description: Calculate a business mileage claim at HMRC's approved rates (55p a mile for the first 10,000 car miles from 2026/27, 45p before; 25p after; motorcycles 24p; bicycles 20p for employees) and the tax it saves. Self-employed: the flat-rate deduction, saving income tax and Class 4 NI. Employee: relief only on the shortfall below what the employer paid, and how to claim it. Passenger payments are tax-free when an employer pays them but can never be claimed.

claimant.description: Who is claiming; defaults to self-employed

employerPencePerMile.description: Employees: what the employer paid per business mile, in pence

passengerTrips.description: Business trips with a fellow employee as passenger

taxBand.description: Income tax band, for the saving; defaults to basic

taxYear.description: Tax year of the miles; defaults to the current year

name: calculate_mileage_allowance
title: Calculate the mileage allowance
